text:
Sasha: Heads-up — cutting a hotfix in ~40m. Need 2 approvals on these PRs before cutoff (no migrations): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6123 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6130. Cutoff 12:00 PT. Ping if you can review, especially @Mike @Anya @Jamal.
Mike: on it, pulling 6123 now :eyes:
Anya: I have a slot after stand, can take 6130 in ~20m.
Jamal: I reviewed 6123 earlier, left one nit about a flakey test. I can push a fix in a minute.
Riley: quick question — do either of these include DB schema changes?
Sasha: no schemas. 6123 reverts a timeout regression, 6130 tweaks batcher config + a small logging change.
Jamal: pushed test fix to 6123 and force-pushed. request review added.
Mike: looked at 6123 after Jamal's patch, tests look stable now. LGTM from me :shipit:
Riley: gave LGTM for 6123 as well.
Sasha: looks like 6123 has 2x approvals — thanks. Anya any blockers on 6130?
Anya: 6130 had a tiny doc suggestion and one optional rename, I pushed suggestion review. No functional change. Adding my approval now. :thumbsup:
Mike: approving 6130 as well, I checked the config surface. LGTM.
Sasha: confirmed both PRs show 2 approvals each. Preparing to merge at cutoff.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: hotfix-canary at 12:05 PT targeting canary pool.
Sasha: merging 6123 then 6130. I'll watch logs for the next 15m — if errors spike we'll rollback. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. :tada:
devops-bot: merge commit created: redwood@9f4a7bd — hotfix/6123
devops-bot: merge commit created: redwood@1d3c2f0 — hotfix/6130
Mike: monitoring metrics dashboard :eyes:
Jamal: will keep an eye on error-rate alert channel.
Anya: filing a quick post-release note in #eng-releases about the revert reason so product knows.
Sasha: nice work team, closing this thread once canary is green. If anyone sees regressions drop them in #incidents and we'll rollback.
Riley: all clear from canary after 7m, no regressions observed.
Sasha: perfect — promoting to prod in 10m.
deploy-bot: production deploy scheduled at 12:20 PT. 
Sasha: done, thanks again — great cross-team response.
